front.title: A Fabric Coordination Layer (FCL) for High-Scale AI Training: Distributed Credit-Orbit Pacing (DCOP) and Global Token Ledger (GTL)

abstract.t:
This document describes a Fabric Coordination Layer (FCL) for high- scale distributed artificial intelligence (AI) training fabrics. FCL coordinates transmission authority using a Global Token Ledger (GTL) and applies that authority through Distributed Credit-Orbit Pacing (DCOP). The architecture relates workload communication intent to available fabric capacity before traffic is injected.
The design objectives are to mitigate synchronized incast, reduce queue pressure and tail-latency variability, and improve collective communication efficiency. These objectives require experimental validation. This revision clarifies the architectural scope and physical constraints of FCL; it does not define an interoperable protocol or a production hardware implementation.
